items.q: The house singer at that time was Harry Belafonte.

ctx.x: I think we were saying this last record was "Focus," and "John's Delight." Right? Are we on the air? Yeah. But this was during the time I worked with Tad, at the Royal Roost. The house singer at that time was Harry Belafonte. And he --
